evidenceBoundary.limits: Documented availability is not runtime verification. Benefits are design inferences. Unknown means not established, not absent. No price or model-quality comparison.

strengths.mechanism: Filtered discovery and premise profiles, with advanced creation fields disclosed separately.
strengths.benefitInference: May reduce setup and premise uncertainty for newcomers.

strengths.mechanism: Named full or partial clones preserve the original; replies support edits and selectable retries.
strengths.benefitInference: May lower the cost of trying an alternate scene.

strengths.mechanism: Individual extracted or manual memories can be edited and pinned.
strengths.benefitInference: May make incorrect story facts easier to repair.

strengths.mechanism: Rulebook meters and status lines connect story state to behavioral rules.
strengths.benefitInference: May make game and relationship progression understandable.

characterOnboarding.note: Search and tag exclusion, premise profiles, creation fields and JSON/PNG import. Definitions may be hidden.

storyOrganization.note: Main Chats shows latest per character; older exact conversations are under Saved Chats within that character.

editRetryBranch.note: Character-message editing, retry variations, and titled full/partial clones. Branch graph or merge not established.

memoryLore.note: Subscriber memory editing/pinning; 250-character entries; deletion cannot be undone. Keyword lore scans the last four messages; one lorebook per character, with edits affecting existing chats.

promptTransparency.note: Partial only: input categories, optional visible definitions and editable memories. Complete assembled-prompt inspection not established.

modelConnections.note: Hosted model selection. OpenAI API-key feature sunset November 17, 2025; arbitrary external endpoints unknown.

advancedControls.note: Temperature, Top-P, Top-K and response limits, with subscription restrictions; broader sampler control unknown.

groupRoleplay.note: 2–10 bots, manual speaker choice, premium automatic choice. Context includes user persona and responding bot persona plus history/memories. No TTS, chat image generation or image sending.

imagesVoice.note: Subscription-dependent conversation images; selectable TTS voices, playback and narration. These media functions exclude groups.

mobile.note: Official Android APK outside Google Play; no current native iOS app. iOS home-screen web route; retained old iOS app is unmaintained. No device tests.

portability.note: Partial: character JSON/PNG import, lorebook JSON import, Rulebook JSON import/export. Chat export and lossless outbound character transfer unknown.

selfHosting.note: No self-hosting distribution or deployment workflow established in the reviewed sources. Hosted operation does not prove self-hosting is unavailable.

tradeoffs.note: Latest-chat navigation adds retrieval steps for older stories.
Support acknowledges history loading failures with many saves; starting a fresh chat does not retrieve the desired story.
Some expert controls require subscriptions. Historical OpenAI-key setup is retired.
Creators can hide character definitions; documented prompt input categories do not establish full prompt visibility.
Memory deletion has no restore; pinning does not establish model compliance.
Lorebook attachment applies across a character's chats, so edits can affect existing stories.
Character imports require manual tags, visibility and advanced fields.
Group drafts are browser/device-local and lost on cache clearing; group media exclusions limit parity with individual chat.
Android installation requires direct APK; no maintained native iOS route is documented.

unknowns.note: Full assembled-prompt inspector and exact per-response context visibility.
Other external endpoint connections after the OpenAI-key retirement.
Lossless chat export, character export and full-account migration. Rulebook export alone does not establish these.
Self-hosting, offline operation and deployable source availability.
Runtime reliability, device usability, accessibility, model quality and Rulebook update accuracy were not tested.

reusablePatterns.proposal: Show premise, greeting and definition visibility beside the start action.
reusablePatterns.benefitInference: May reduce uncertainty about the scene and hidden instructions.

reusablePatterns.proposal: Offer named full/partial clones with a clearly identified source.
reusablePatterns.benefitInference: May support story experiments with a recoverable original.

reusablePatterns.proposal: Expose memory corrections in the story and distinguish extracted from user-pinned facts.
reusablePatterns.benefitInference: May improve user control of continuity.

reusablePatterns.proposal: Consider optional story meters with readable rules and inspectable changes.
Preview imported fields and identify manual completion needs.
reusablePatterns.benefitInference: May make partial migration and validation failures understandable.

doNotCopy.note: Latest-only top-level conversation navigation makes older exact stories harder to find.
Irreversible memory deletion needs a recovery affordance before adopting an equivalent design.
Browser-only drafts need explicit persistence warnings and an export/recovery path.
Do not equate hidden definitions or editable memory snippets with complete prompt transparency.
